quest.title: Vishaps and Where to Find Them
quest.description: Recently, a lot of unusual phenomena have been occurring all over Liyue. According to some, they may be related to a monster depicted in ancient texts, the Geovishap. Katheryne of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild posted an urgent commission, calling adventurers to investigate the irregularities.

talks.objective: Talk to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome, Adventurer. I've been waiting for your arrival.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for your concern, I'm fine. However, the Guild is facing yet another emergency...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: In the past few days, the Adventurers' Guild has received many eyewitness reports of Geovishaps.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Up till recently, the only known Geovishap sightings were those recorded in ancient texts. No one knows why they are suddenly making an appearance now.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: They look quite similar to Geovishap Hatchlings, but they are very aggressive and possess far more destructive power.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: During this time, many people are heading out to remote locations to sight-see and release lanterns. If they were to run into a Geovishap, the consequences would be dire indeed.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Unfortunately for us, many adventurers have now gone to see their families and friends. As such, we're currently experiencing a severe shortage of staff.

choices.text: Have you tried asking the Millelith?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: They're facing the same situation as we are. Keeping the peace is a duty of equal importance to them, after all.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Considering your excellent performance recently, I feel that you are the only sensible choice for solving this particular issue.

choices.text: Fair enough, since it's an emergency.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Thank you for agreeing to help. First, we need you to follow the trail of the Geovishaps and ascertain their whereabouts.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I'm sure that you're familiar with the Guild's expedition system. I have organized the leads we have regarding the Geovishaps into a similar format.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Time is against us, so let's have a look.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The key difference between these expeditions and the normal ones is that the Guild has already conducted some preliminary investigations. If we act on the information we've already gathered, we should be able to dramatically improve the efficiency of our work.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: The Guild will rank these expeditions based on the time required and the amount of risk involved. The higher the level, the greater the rewards.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If we amass the intelligence gathered from these leads, I am confident that we will be able to pinpoint the whereabouts of the Geovishaps.

choices.text: Then we take them out, I presume.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Indeed. Ah, and one other thing — we will update the available intelligence daily. In the meantime, I will do all that I can to support you and your friends as you investigate.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: On that note, I shall leave the Geovishap investigation to you. Good luck. Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: What do you need me to do?
Can we call for reinforcements from other Guild branches?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Unfortunately, the situation in other branches is... somewhat complicated. We've received some backup, but it is far from enough.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Indeed, and it is an emergency.
